method: Labelled after the questions were frozen (sha256 in held_out_freeze), from the official documents of the enabled sources. answerable: yes = an enabled source states a complete answer; partial = part of the ask, a premise correction or an authority/policy case; no = no enabled source. plan_f_should_serve: true = a verified Plan F answer is expected; false = Plan F must not serve; null = either a verified answer or a fallback is acceptable.

frozen.author: an independent agent given only document titles and categories; it read no project file
